---
title: "DESeq2 sex check"
author: "Daniel Gregory"
format: html
editor: visual
---

Testing if adding sex as a covariate changes up/down-regulated results and if gene-by-gene there are significant interaction effects due to sex.

Inputs are saved at the end of `deseq2-analysis.qmd`.

```{r}
library(DESeq2)

inp <- readRDS("data/processed/deseq2_output_Brain_Cortex_vs_Whole_Blood.rds")
dds <- readRDS("data/processed/deseq2_dds_Brain_Cortex_vs_Whole_Blood.rds")
res <- inp$res
target <- inp$settings$target
ref <- inp$settings$ref
alpha <- inp$settings$alpha
lfc_cutoff <- inp$settings$lfc_cutoff
```

```{r}
table(dds$SEX, dds$group) # 1 = male, 2 = female

dds_sex <- dds
dds_sex$SEX <- factor(ifelse(dds_sex$SEX == 1, "Male", "Female"), levels = c("Male", "Female"))

# 1. Sex as a covariate
design(dds_sex) <- ~ SEX + group
res_cov <- results(DESeq(dds_sex, quiet = TRUE), contrast = c("group", target, ref))
hits <- res$padj < alpha & abs(res$log2FoldChange) > lfc_cutoff
hits_cov <- res_cov$padj < alpha & abs(res_cov$log2FoldChange) > lfc_cutoff
c(without_sex = sum(hits, na.rm = TRUE), with_sex = sum(hits_cov, na.rm = TRUE), in_both = sum(hits & hits_cov, na.rm = TRUE))

# 2. Sex x tissue interaction
design(dds_sex) <- ~ SEX + group + SEX:group
res_int <- results(DESeq(dds_sex, quiet = TRUE), name = paste0("SEXFemale.group", target))
sum(res_int$padj < alpha, na.rm = TRUE) # genes where the tissue difference depends on sex
head(data.frame(symbol = res$symbol, lfc = res_int$log2FoldChange, padj = res_int$padj)[order(res_int$padj), ], 10)
```
